added_failures_note: Reviewed baseline_suite exit 4 has no tests and no failure IDs; after_suite exit 0 has one passed and no failure IDs, hence observed head-only IDs are empty. This is not a completed matched regression comparison.

assertion_analysis.fails_if: the first station tick never requests a sweep
the sweep thread remains blocked after release
the due request is dropped or replayed more than once
the replayed sweep does not invoke the local review recorder after delivery
the replayed sweep does not invoke the local repair recorder after delivery
the recovery report does not carry the local recorder review output
the recovery report does not carry the local recorder repair output

findings.text: blocking: the recorded instance has no exact sweep request or start timestamp, so the explicitly required historical timing evidence is absent.
blocking: replacing dispatch_awaiting_reviews with a local recorder makes the review and repair assertions report simulated outcomes rather than proving the real duties dispatched and opened.
blocking: the purported matched head arm records the base SHA, so the 12 passing cases cannot establish a zero-failure delta against the landed head.
